method: Independent direct HTTP status, redirect, media-type and content-hash checks plus National Grid audited accounts, Stonepeak, SEC, JERA and FERC/NEPOOL inspection; identity, ownership, closing and exit search

verifiedClaims: New England Power Company operates electric transmission facilities in Massachusetts, New Hampshire and Vermont
NEP is wholly owned by National Grid USA, which is wholly owned through National Grid North America by National Grid plc
At March 31, 2026 NEP reported $4.346 billion of net PP&E and $5.253 billion of total assets
Subsequent events were evaluated through June 17, 2026 with no undisclosed ownership event
Stonepeak New England Power is a separate Canal I-III and Bucksport generation portfolio exceeding 1,600 MW
Stonepeak reports a June 2018 investment, a 2019 Bucksport follow-on and sale to JERA Americas in May 2022
The Canal transaction closed June 29, 2018 for $320 million subject to adjustment
Stonepeak Infrastructure Fund II supplied equity and an affiliate simultaneously acquired Canal 3
JERA signed to acquire a 100% interest in the Stonepeak thermal generation projects in Massachusetts and Maine
The announcement did not describe a National Grid transmission investment
FERC authorized the sale of 100% of Canal Power Holdings LLC to a JERA Americas affiliate on November 23, 2022
The applicants reported consummation on December 1, 2022
The report identifies Canal, Canal 3 and Bucksport as the Stonepeak seller perimeter
National Grid's acquisition of NEES closed March 22, 2000
NEP kept its name and remained wholly owned by National Grid USA

exitSearch.result: No Stonepeak investment in New England Power Company's transmission business was found. The actual Stonepeak New England Power generation portfolio was sold in full to JERA and closed December 1, 2022; NEP remained National Grid-controlled through the latest audited evidence.

responseSourceHealthCorrections: National Grid's download and three SEC pages blocked direct automated retrieval but were independently verified through indexed first-party web content; recorded hashes for blocked requests are hashes of the block responses.
Stonepeak's portfolio label refers to merchant generation, not New England Power Company's regulated transmission business.
The Stonepeak portfolio page's May 2022 sale wording is treated as announcement timing; FERC/NEPOOL evidence supplies the December 1, 2022 legal closing.
